title: yaks sync keyword vocabulary
description: The keyword @yaks/sync adds to a component vocabulary: where a component's data lives. A client graph holds three kinds of state at once — what the server owns, what this browser owns, and what only this render owns — and the tier is declared once, on the component, rather than decided again at every call site.
$comment: A vocabulary declaration in the JSON Schema sense: a URI that names this keyword set, plus the schema of each keyword. A vocab file declares it under $vocabulary.

persist.description: Which tier this component persists to. "wire" (the default) is synced to the server; "local" is kept by this client and never sent; "none" is ephemeral, held only while the process lives.
